about: What the smallest terminal application with its agent endpoint loads (CF1's F4; terminal design §5, the second tier): omui.size.terminal-agent built size-optimised, as the terminal design states its tiers (§5: the workspace's `small` profile, -Oz, NDEBUG, the system's C and C++ runtimes), with its symbol table kept, the allocated sections of its program counted (.bss and the symbols left out). Bytes.

budgets.why: The terminal design's second tier (§5, D-219): 2 MB — the first tier's 1 MB and about 1 MB for the endpoint (the bus, JSON, the spec's types). Measured 5,183,427 B (2026-11-26, GCC 16 on Linux x64, the system's C++ runtime; 5,190,968 B stripped): over it, a red with the first tier's. Over terminal's 3,382,445 B the endpoint costs 1,800,982 B: omui.agent, mlibs.agent, omui.semantic and openkal's rights table 16% of the code, its JSON and the screenshot's PNG encoder; its code by owner otherwise as terminal's — omui.view 20%, the view's pixel parts 22%, the standard library's instantiations 15%. What brings it down: the first tier's levers, and the endpoint's own share (size design §5.4); tests/bench/competitors/terminal/README.md; 2026-11-27 (UI7, CF1): 3,849,938 B loaded (3,858,288 B stripped), still over it — the first tier's cuts, and the agent's captures a slot of their own the terminal does not install (install_endpoint: no PNG coder, SVG writer or renderer, and through them no effects' shaders): -1,340,982 B. Over terminal's 2,211,981 B the endpoint and the face now cost 1,637,957 B: omui.agent 6%, mlibs.agent 4%, openkal's rights table 4% (a 128 KiB table in .data), omui.semantic 3.4%, JSON 4%, and more of the view the interface's operations reach. At -Oz (the workspace's `web` profile) 2,006,144 B stripped; 2026-11-27, later (CF1): at the workspace's `small` profile (-Oz, NDEBUG, as the design states the tiers) 2,001,804 B at 1d69ab4e's code, over it by 1,804; with the first tier's cuts, and its catalog registered by name (register_base_named<"button", "column", "row", "text">: what it builds, as a closure registers what scripts name): 1,835,968 B loaded (1,846,336 B stripped) — within it. openkal-linux's tables in .bss would take 141,824 B more (mcpplibs/openkal-linux#61: 131,072 B of handles and 10,752 B of roots now in .data)

links_why: The packages built into the program (B5): a change to this list is a change to what the smallest terminal application with an agent endpoint carries, said in review. Owed: what only pixels use — mrender.raster, mrender.vector, mrender.graph, mrender.text, hanim.visual, mlibs.image and its decoders (mcpplibs.mwrap.libjpeg_turbo, .libpng, .libwebp; compat.libpng, compat.libwebp, compat.zlib), mlibs.pipeline, mlibs.rhi and the solver (mlibs.dynamics, mlibs.simulation) — reached through omui.view and hanim (terminal design §9 step ③, B6). 2026-11-27: those packages are still built in, their bytes are not (UI7: read at slots no terminal installs); the list is unchanged
